general.label: General
general.description: Lore, Custom Name, Unbreakable and more

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: CraftEngine item settings (Tags, Fuel Time, Repair …)

blockSettings.label: Block Settings
blockSettings.description: Properties of the placed block (Hardness, Sounds, Tags, Loot …)

dataLore.label: Lore
dataLore.description: Text lines below the item name (MiniMessage, e.g. '<'gray>).

dataCustomName.label: Custom Name
dataCustomName.description: A name that overrides the display name, like one given in an anvil. Italic unless you turn it off.

dataUnbreakable.label: Unbreakable
dataUnbreakable.description: The item does not lose durability.

dataHideTooltip.label: Hide Tooltip
dataHideTooltip.description: Hides the tooltip lines of these components.

dataPdc.label: PDC
dataPdc.description: Custom data in the PersistentDataContainer of the item, for other plugins.

clientBoundMaterial.label: Client Bound Material
clientBoundMaterial.description: The material players see. The server keeps the real material.

dataInsertLore.label: Insert Lore
dataInsertLore.description: Inserts lines into the lore at a position.

dataRemoveLore.label: Remove Lore
dataRemoveLore.description: Removes the lore lines that match a regular expression.

dataTooltipStyle.label: Tooltip Style
dataTooltipStyle.description: The background texture of the tooltip.

dataDyedColor.label: Dyed Color
dataDyedColor.description: The color of dyeable items such as leather armor, as r,g,b.

dataTrim.label: Trim
dataTrim.description: An armor trim with pattern and material.

dataProfile.label: Profile
dataProfile.description: The skin of a player head: a player name, a texture URL or base64.

dataFood.label: Food
dataFood.description: Food values when eaten. The item also needs a consumable component to be edible.

dataEquippable.label: Equippable
dataEquippable.description: The item can be worn in an equipment slot.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

equipOnInteract.label: Can be put on a mob by using it

dataUseRemainder.label: Use Remainder
dataUseRemainder.description: The item that is left after using this one.

dataAttributeModifiers.label: Attribute Modifiers
dataAttributeModifiers.description: Vanilla attribute modifiers, e.g. more attack damage in the main hand.

dataPaintingVariant.label: Painting Variant
dataPaintingVariant.description: The painting a painting item places.

dataJukeboxPlayable.label: Jukebox Playable
dataJukeboxPlayable.description: The song a jukebox plays with this item.

dataExternal.label: External
dataExternal.description: Takes the data of an item from another plugin.

dataComponents.label: Components
dataComponents.description: Raw vanilla data components. CraftEngine does not check them across versions.

dataRemoveComponents.label: Remove Components
dataRemoveComponents.description: Removes these components from the item.

clientBoundData.label: Client Bound Data
clientBoundData.description: Item data that is only sent to players and resolved for each of them, such as conditional names and lore.
clientBoundData.hint: Takes the same keys as data. Use conditional#name entries for data that depends on conditions.

settingsTags.label: Tags
settingsTags.description: Item tags the item belongs to, e.g. for recipes.

settingsFuelTime.label: Fuel Time
settingsFuelTime.description: How long the item burns as furnace fuel, in ticks.

settingsFuelRemainder.label: Fuel Remainder
settingsFuelRemainder.description: The item left in the furnace after burning. Only for items that do not stack.

settingsBreakPower.label: Break Power
settingsBreakPower.description: Mining level of the tool. Blocks with a required break power need at least this value.

settingsRepairable.label: Repairable
settingsRepairable.description: Whether the item can be repaired in a crafting table, anvil or grindstone.

settingsAnvilRepairItem.label: Anvil Repair Item
settingsAnvilRepairItem.description: Set on a repair material: the items it repairs in an anvil.

settingsDragRepairItem.label: Drag Repair Item
settingsDragRepairItem.description: Set on a repair material: the items it repairs when dropped onto them in the inventory.

settingsRespectRepairableComponent.label: Respect Repairable Component
settingsRespectRepairableComponent.description: The anvil follows the vanilla repairable component of the item.

settingsRenameable.label: Renameable
settingsRenameable.description: Whether the item can be renamed in an anvil.

settingsEnchantable.label: Enchantable
settingsEnchantable.description: Whether the item can be used in an enchanting table.

settingsPreventBreak.label: Prevent Break
settingsPreventBreak.description: The item keeps its last durability point instead of breaking.

settingsCanPlace.label: Can Place
settingsCanPlace.description: Whether the vanilla block of the material can be placed.

settingsDyeable.label: Dyeable
settingsDyeable.description: Whether the item can be dyed in a crafting table.

settingsDyeColor.label: Dye Color
settingsDyeColor.description: The color the item adds in dye recipes, as r,g,b.

settingsFireworkColor.label: Firework Color
settingsFireworkColor.description: The color the item adds to a firework star fade, as r,g,b.

settingsEquipment.label: Equipment
settingsEquipment.description: Applies a CraftEngine equipment definition when the item is worn.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

equipOnInteract.label: Can be put on a mob by using it

settingsConsumeReplacement.label: Consume Replacement
settingsConsumeReplacement.description: The item a player gets back after consuming this one.

settingsCraftRemainder.label: Craft Remainder
settingsCraftRemainder.description: The item left in the crafting grid after crafting.

settingsAllowedProjectiles.label: Allowed Projectiles
settingsAllowedProjectiles.description: Items a bow or crossbow can shoot.

settingsIngredientSubstitute.label: Ingredient Substitute
settingsIngredientSubstitute.description: Vanilla items this item can stand in for in recipes.

settingsCompostProbability.label: Compost Probability
settingsCompostProbability.description: Chance that the item raises the composter level (0–1).

settingsInvulnerable.label: Invulnerable
settingsInvulnerable.description: Damage causes a dropped item survives.

settingsKeepOnDeathChance.label: Keep On Death Chance
settingsKeepOnDeathChance.description: Chance that a player keeps the item on death (0–1).

settingsDestroyOnDeathChance.label: Destroy On Death Chance
settingsDestroyOnDeathChance.description: Chance that the item is destroyed on death (0–1).

settingsGlowColor.label: Glow Color
settingsGlowColor.description: The glow color of the dropped item.

settingsProjectile.label: Projectile
settingsProjectile.description: A custom projectile entity, e.g. for a trident.

blockSettingsHardness.label: Hardness
blockSettingsHardness.description: How long the block takes to break. Stone has 1.5, obsidian 50.

blockSettingsResistance.label: Resistance
blockSettingsResistance.description: How well the block withstands explosions.

blockSettingsTags.label: Tags
blockSettingsTags.description: Block tags of the block, e.g. the tool that mines it fast (minecraft:mineable/pickaxe).

blockSettingsSounds.label: Sounds
blockSettingsSounds.description: The sounds of the block: break, step, place, hit while mining and fall.

blockSettingsCorrectTools.label: Correct Tools
blockSettingsCorrectTools.description: Tools or item tags that get the drops. Setting it turns on Require Correct Tools.

blockSettingsRequireCorrectTools.label: Require Correct Tools
blockSettingsRequireCorrectTools.description: The block drops something only when it is mined with a correct tool.

blockSettingsRequiredBreakPower.label: Required Break Power
blockSettingsRequiredBreakPower.description: The break power a tool needs: wood and gold 1, stone and copper 2, iron 3, diamond 4, netherite 5.

blockSettingsIncorrectToolDigSpeed.label: Incorrect Tool Dig Speed
blockSettingsIncorrectToolDigSpeed.description: Dig speed with a wrong tool, as a share of the normal speed (0 to 1).

blockSettingsLuminance.label: Luminance
blockSettingsLuminance.description: The light level the block gives off (0 to 15).

blockSettingsMapColor.label: Map Color
blockSettingsMapColor.description: The color id of the block on maps, e.g. 11 for stone.

blockSettingsPushReaction.label: Push Reaction
blockSettingsPushReaction.description: What a piston does with the block.

blockSettingsInstrument.label: Instrument
blockSettingsInstrument.description: The sound of a note block that stands on the block.

blockSettingsBurnable.label: Burnable
blockSettingsBurnable.description: Fire from the surroundings can set the block alight.

blockSettingsBurnChance.label: Burn Chance
blockSettingsBurnChance.description: How likely the block catches fire (0 to 100).

blockSettingsFireSpreadChance.label: Fire Spread Chance
blockSettingsFireSpreadChance.description: How likely fire on the block spreads to its neighbors (0 to 100).

blockSettingsReplaceable.label: Replaceable
blockSettingsReplaceable.description: Placing another block on it replaces it, like grass.

blockSettingsIsSuffocating.label: Is Suffocating
blockSettingsIsSuffocating.description: Entities inside the block take suffocation damage.

blockSettingsIsViewBlocking.label: Is View Blocking
blockSettingsIsViewBlocking.description: The block blocks the view of mobs. Players still see what the model shows.

blockSettingsIsRandomlyTicking.label: Is Randomly Ticking
blockSettingsIsRandomlyTicking.description: The block gets random ticks, which some block behaviors need (growing, spreading).

blockSettingsCanOcclude.label: Can Occlude
blockSettingsCanOcclude.description: The block stops light from passing and turns grass below it into dirt.

blockSettingsBlockLight.label: Block Light
blockSettingsBlockLight.description: How much the block weakens light that passes through it (0 to 15).

blockSettingsFriction.label: Friction
blockSettingsFriction.description: How slippery the block is for mobs and items. Ice has 0.98. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsSpeedFactor.label: Speed Factor
blockSettingsSpeedFactor.description: Changes how fast mobs walk on the block. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsJumpFactor.label: Jump Factor
blockSettingsJumpFactor.description: Changes how high mobs jump from the block. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsBounceRestitution.label: Bounce Restitution
blockSettingsBounceRestitution.description: How high mobs bounce after landing on the block. Slime has 1. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsSupportShape.label: Support Shape
blockSettingsSupportShape.description: The vanilla block whose shape the block offers to neighbors, e.g. for torches on its side.

blockLoot.label: Loot
blockLoot.description: What the block drops when it breaks. default:loot_table/self drops the block itself. Without loot the block drops nothing.
